name: BUTYLHIOSCINE 10 MG 10 TABLETS
description: Butylscopolamine, available in 10 mg tablets (10 tablets per pack), is an antispasmodic medication that relieves pain caused by spasms in the smooth muscles of the gastrointestinal, biliary, and genitourinary tracts. It works by relaxing the muscles to reduce cramps and associated pain. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
